name: MFA for every human user
risk: A phished password gives an attacker console access to the account
statement: Cloud/IAM engineering ensures every IAM user with a console password has an MFA device, checked daily against the IAM credential report.
cis_aws: MFA enabled for all IAM users with a console password
pass_rule: Fail if any IAM user with a console password has no MFA

name: Root account locked down
risk: The most powerful login is phished or its keys leak
statement: Cloud/IAM engineering ensures the root user has MFA, has no access keys and is used only for break-glass tasks, checked daily against the credential report.
cis_aws: Root user has MFA and no access keys
pass_rule: Fail if root has no MFA or any active access key; at risk if root was used in the last 30 days

name: Access keys rotated and used
risk: An old or forgotten key still works after it leaks
statement: Cloud/IAM engineering ensures active access keys are rotated within 90 days and unused keys are removed, checked daily against the credential report.
cis_aws: Access keys rotated every 90 days or less
pass_rule: Fail if an active key is older than 90 days; at risk after 75 days or if an active key has never been used after 7 days

name: Audit logging on in all regions
risk: You can't investigate activity you never recorded
statement: Cloud engineering ensures a multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging with log file validation, checked daily against the CloudTrail API.
pass_rule: Fail if no multi-region trail is logging; at risk if logging but single-region or without log file validation

name: Storage not public
risk: Customer data in a bucket is exposed to the internet
statement: Cloud engineering ensures S3 Block Public Access is on for the account and every bucket, and every bucket has default encryption, checked daily against the S3 APIs.
cis_aws: S3 Block Public Access enabled at account level
evidence_source: AWS S3 and S3 Control APIs
pass_rule: Fail if any bucket can be public; at risk if Block Public Access is not set at account level

name: Changes reviewed before merge
statement: Engineering ensures the main branch requires an approved pull request before merge, checked daily against GitHub branch protection and rulesets.
evidence_source: GitHub branch protection and rulesets API
pass_rule: Fail if main can be changed without an approved pull request

name: Vulnerable dependencies fixed on time
statement: Engineering ensures Dependabot alerts are on and critical, high and medium alerts are fixed within 15, 30 and 90 days, checked daily against the Dependabot alerts API.
pass_rule: Fail if alerts are off or any alert is past its SLA; at risk if open critical or high alerts are within SLA

name: No secrets in code
risk: A credential leaks through the repository
statement: Engineering ensures secret scanning and push protection are on and every open secret scanning alert is revoked and closed, checked daily against the secret scanning API.
pass_rule: Fail if secret scanning is off or any alert is open

name: AI agent uses only approved tools
risk: An AI agent takes actions nobody approved
statement: AI governance ensures every agent has a named owner, uses only approved tools, and needs human approval for any tool that writes data, checked on every change to the agent config.
pass_rule: Fail if the owner is missing, a tool is not approved, or a write tool skips human approval

name: No critical or high CVEs in shipped dependencies
risk: A vulnerable library ships inside the product
statement: Engineering ensures shipped dependencies have no known critical or high CVEs, checked by a Trivy scan on every build.
pass_rule: Fail if any critical or high CVE is found or no Trivy evidence exists

name: No secrets committed to code
risk: A hardcoded key gives direct access
statement: Engineering ensures no secrets are committed to code, checked by a gitleaks scan on every change.
pass_rule: Fail if any leak is found or no gitleaks evidence exists
